Ed Euromaus and Snorri welcome you to the new app of Europa-Park and the indoor water world Rulantica. Whether you are planning your visit, buy tickets, check queue times of attractions during your visit, look at showtimes, navigate through the park or want to stay up do date on the news around Europa-Park, Rulantica, the hotel resort, or our events – the app is your ideal companion before, during and after your stay at the Europa-Park Theme Park and Resort.

MackOne
The centralised log-in service for the digital world of the Europa-Park Theme Park and Resort.

VirtualLine
Simply queue digitally in the app and discover Europa-Park while you wait. You will be notified as soon as it is your turn.

Detailed park map
Discover quickly and easily what is near you or navigate to your next adventure. You have to agree to using GPS in order to use this service.

Overview of current queueing times and showtimes
During your visit in the park you can see the current queueing times and start times of our shows. Don’t forget: You have to agree to using GPS in order to be located.

Buy tickets quickly and easily
Buy your entry tickets, event tickets or parking tickets directly in the app via our online ticket shop and safe having to queue on site.

Individual filters
Delicious paella in Spain, nicely smelling crêpes in France or vegetarian curry in the restaurant Spices – Cuisines of the World? Set the filters to your taste and see the matching results directly in the park map.

VEEJOY, the streaming platform of the Europa-Park Resort
Look forward to exciting background information about different resort attractions, as well as emotionally told stories, exciting movies and series and entertaining podcasts, directly in the app.

And much more is waiting for you…
